sections.heading: What we collect
sections.text: The details you submit through the contact form (name, email, business name, the service you need and your project description) and standard server logs. We do not collect payment card data.

sections.heading: Why
sections.text: To respond to your enquiry and, where you agree, to follow up about our services. We do not sell your data or use it for unrelated purposes.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.text: Enquiries are kept only as long as needed to respond and, if a project follows, for its duration — then deleted. Access is restricted to the Keelbiz team.

sections.heading: Analytics and advertising
sections.text: This site currently uses no advertising pixels and no tracking cookies. If privacy-friendly analytics are added, they will be cookieless. See the Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask what we hold about you, request correction or deletion, or withdraw consent at any time by contacting us through the enquiry form.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: These terms cover use of this website. Service engagements are governed by a separate written proposal and agreement.

sections.heading: No guarantees
sections.text: Demos on this site use sample or illustrative data. We do not promise specific results, revenue or return on investment.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.text: Site content, designs and code are © Keelbiz unless stated otherwise. Reuse requires written permission.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.text: This website is provided for general information. To the extent permitted by law, Keelbiz is not liable for losses arising from its use. Liability for project work is set out in each project agreement.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.text: The governing law and jurisdiction are stated in each project agreement.

sections.heading: Default
sections.text: This site sets no non-essential cookies by default. Preferences such as dark mode are stored locally in your browser only.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.text: If analytics are enabled they are cookieless (Plausible or Umami). No consent banner is required for these.

sections.heading: Advertising
sections.text: No advertising pixels are currently used on this site. If one is added, it will load only after you accept it in the cookie settings.
